name: Masks
overview: Scripture reveals that masks, both literal and figurative, serve as symbols of hidden intentions and deception. Moses physically veiled his face after speaking with God, indicating a separation between divine encounter and human perception (Exodus 34:33). Similarly, the adulterer conceals his face to hide his sin under cover of darkness (Job 24:15), while false prophets disguise their true nature with outward appearances (Matthew 7:15). The heart’s true thoughts and feelings often remain concealed behind outward expressions, as seen in Proverbs where deceitful lips mask hateful intentions and inward deceit (Proverbs 26:24; 23:7). These verses collectively warn believers to discern beyond outward appearances and seek the truth revealed by God.
